answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier scans every output like a lantern searching a dark cave for hidden reuse, ensuring no logic paths overlap. Like a marble rolling along a track, every agent must lock its proof to a non-transferable slot. Any identity found to echo another submission triggers an immediate audit, resulting in permanent exclusion and zero refunds, as parallel puzzle solving prevents the pooling of efforts.
